description: This file contains server-side logic for username validation, including checking blacklists, generating suggestions, and handling username availability in different contexts within a web application.

methods.name: isBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if a username is in the blacklist, fetching the blacklist data from a URL if not already cached.

methods.name: isPremiumUserName
methods.description: Determines if a username qualifies as a premium username based on length or blacklist status, depending on feature flag.

methods.name: generateUsernameSuggestion
methods.description: Generates a unique username suggestion by appending a random number to the base username.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Converts a result string into a username status object with a status code and message.

methods.name: usernameHandler
methods.description: Higher-order function that wraps a handler to process username validation and status before invoking the handler.

methods.name: usernameCheck
methods.description: Checks if a username is available, premium, and generates suggestions if not, considering organization context.

methods.name: isUsernameReservedDueToMigration
methods.description: Checks if a username is reserved due to a migration redirect.

methods.name: usernameCheckForSignup
methods.description: Checks username availability during signup, considering existing user data and organization membership.
